name: CDN
certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Engineer Associate

beginner.summary: For web developers, system administrators and junior cloud or network engineers who serve websites or APIs and are new to content delivery networks. Covers how edge locations, PoPs and origins fit together, the HTTP caching model from RFC 9111 (Cache-Control, validators, Age), reading cache status headers on Amazon CloudFront and Cloudflare, building first distributions and zones, cache keys, TTL precedence, purge and invalidation, versioned assets, compression, edge TLS and custom domains, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 from the viewer side, origin error codes, custom error pages, geo restriction and measuring hit ratio and TTFB, ending with a static website capstone.
prerequisites: Understands HTTP requests, status codes and headers at the level of using browser developer tools
Uses a terminal confidently, including curl, dig and environment variables
Has an AWS account and a free Cloudflare account, a domain name they control and rights to create S3 buckets and DNS records
outcomes: Explain the CDN request path from viewer to edge, through optional tiers, to origin, and predict whether a response will be cached
Create and configure a CloudFront distribution and a Cloudflare zone with HTTPS, custom domains and cache rules
Control freshness with Cache-Control, validators, TTL settings and versioned filenames, and remove stale content with purge or invalidation
Diagnose cache misses and origin errors from response headers and report hit ratio, TTFB and origin offload
